# Net Volume

*Bar volume signed by the close-to-close move.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Net Volume** under **Volume**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Up color | color | `"#089981"` |
| Down color | color | `"#F23645"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/netvolume.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Net Volume", shortTitle: "Net Vol", overlay: false, format: "volume" });
const nv = ta.calc([ta.change(candle.close, 1), candle.volume], (d, v) => (d > 0 ? v : d < 0 ? -v : 0));
plot(nv, { title: "Net Volume", style: "columns", colorUp: input.color("Up color", "#089981", { group: "Style" }), colorDown: input.color("Down color", "#F23645", { group: "Style" }) });
```
